description: Compares ShortestHopCountRouting, LeastLossRouting and HighestFidelityRouting on the diamond topology (see docs/campaign_architecture.md), where they genuinely disagree (notebooks 12/16 of Fase H2). Deliberately does NOT sweep attenuation_db_per_m here: the current sweep mechanism applies a swept topology parameter to every quantum link uniformly, which would erase the diamond's deliberate bad/good link asymmetry (the whole reason the three strategies diverge) instead of scaling it. A per-link-targeted sweep would be needed to vary attenuation meaningfully on this topology - out of scope for this validation campaign (see docs/campaign_architecture.md, limitations).
